tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Basic facts about STORE INVENT & PARTNERS, s.r.o.: history, scale, coverage, technology, contacts.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List of all 6 inventory services with short descriptions and detail page URLs.

tools.name: get_service_details
tools.description: Details of one service: what it includes, how it works, practical notes.

tools.name: get_quote_requirements
tools.description: What information the sales team needs to prepare a quote (pricing is always individual), plus data-format details and inventory preparation advice. Call this before submit_inquiry.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Frequently asked questions and answers about the services.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Submit a real non-binding inquiry (nezávazná poptávka) to the sales team. They reply to the given e-mail, usually within 24 hours on business days. Collect the details from get_quote_requirements first and include them in the message.

tools.name: ask_question
tools.description: Ask a free-form question about the company or its inventory services; answered from the company knowledge base (Czech or English).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_services · Private data: get_company_info · Public sink: submit_inquiry · Destructive: get_quote_requirements.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_services · Private data: get_company_info · Public sink: submit_inquiry · Destructive: get_quote_requirements

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
